title: Upper-limb elbow-centered motor imagery dataset (10 classes)
description: EEG recordings from 12 healthy, BCI-naive participants performing kinesthetic motor imagery of upper-limb, elbow-centered tasks. The paradigm has 10 classes: rest, elbow flexion, and eight goal-directed daily-living tasks such as drawer opening, soup eating, weight lifting and combing. Data were recorded with a 17-channel EGI system at 1000 Hz. The dataset supports research on the versatility of EEG models for motor-imagery BCI control and rehabilitation.
methods_description: EEG was recorded with an EGI Geodesic Net Amps 400 series amplifier (17 channels, Ag/AgCl sponge electrodes, Cz reference, 1000 Hz sampling, 0.1-40 Hz online bandpass). Stimuli were presented with BCI2000. Each participant completed 15 runs of 24 trials, with picture cues followed by kinesthetic motor imagery and randomized rest periods of 4-6 s.
